action.body: Please review INV-049’s two GBP 18.00 lines for the same DL-049 delivery service and date. If duplication is confirmed, issue the authorised credit and revised invoice balance.

later_events.body: Duplicate confirmed: line 2 repeats line 1, not a second service. [Credit and revised statement](attachments/credit-statement.pdf): CN-049 credits GBP 18.00 against INV-049; revised amount due GBP 18.00. No money has been refunded because nothing was paid.
